name: Double Unders
instructions: Hold a jump rope with both hands, positioning the rope behind your feet.
Stand with feet together and elbows close to your sides.
Jump slightly higher than a normal jump rope skip.
As you jump, quickly rotate your wrists to spin the rope fast enough to pass under your feet twice before landing.
Keep your jumps consistent and your core tight.
Focus on wrist rotation rather than large arm movements.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm throughout.
